source_note: Preserved portfolio snapshot for a 2004 Ford F-150. Results were recorded before the AWS serving pause; no browser inference or additional vehicle predictions are performed.
source_limitations: Original trained model, source review text, and per-snapshot artifact hash are not included in the public site. Source IDs and titles are recorded evidence metadata, not newly retrieved reviews.

questions.reliability: What do owners mention about reliability and common problems?
questions.maintenance: What maintenance issues and repair costs do owners mention?
questions.comfort: What do owners say about comfort and everyday driving?
questions.fuel_economy: What do owners mention about fuel economy and efficiency?

2004|reliability.heading: Reliability experiences were mixed.
2004|reliability.answer: Retrieved reviews included owners describing costly reliability problems as well as owners reporting long-term dependability. The system keeps the answer tied to the specific retrieved evidence instead of presenting one anecdote as universal.

evaluation.context: Saved project-level evaluation, not a score measured on this one Ford F-150 example.

answerability.benchmark: Held-out weakly supervised benchmark across unseen vehicle families
